integrity.computation_scope: Two prime fields, cycles of lengths four and six, up to six cover edges; characteristic-independent proof is provided.
integrity.evidence: Complete symbolic proof and six exhaustive direct multiplication-and-rank tests in standalone check_rank.py.

scientific_limitations: Only connected height-two posets with simple unicyclic comparability graphs, all finite fields.
Counts inner derivations, not all derivations; the element-indexed count and distinct-map count differ by the center cardinality.
No independent audit has been performed; full-text access to two adjacent publisher articles was unavailable.
title: Inner-derivation rank polynomials of unicyclic height-two incidence algebras
